_doc: Per-enemy design direction (lead-authored). Data facts (name, description, behaviour, tags/faction, radius, boss) are added by handoff.py brief. Launch enemies without a faction tag are Rift-born: ash-grey husk flesh or stone, faint wine-red rift cracks, fragments of the fallen sanctum guard's armour. Size class: small | medium | brute | boss. Never cute: no big round eyes, no blob bodies.

grunt.design: Hunched rift-born husk, a broken guard helmet fused into the skull, glowing rift cracks on chest and forearms, jagged notched blade, torn tabard. Attack: blade chop toward +X.

runner.design: Rift Hound: lean skeletal quadruped of grey husk and exposed rift-glow ribs, long jaw, low to the ground, legs mid-gallop. a/b = gallop phases. Attack: lunging bite toward +X.

swarmling.design: Tiny rift crawler (shown at x0.8): a spiny insect-like husk with a cracked shell and two glowing pin eyes, many legs. Must read as a crowd unit at ~45 px. Attack: leap with claws forward.

shieldbearer.design: Husk soldier behind a battered TOWER SHIELD of sanctum steel reinforced with rift-stone, only the helm and a spear tip visible above. The shield faces +X. Attack: shield shove with spear jab.

hexcaster.design: Elongated tattered robes, tall horned hood, emaciated grey arms, floating wine-violet hex sigil above the raised hand. Attack: both hands thrust toward +X, sigil flaring.

sapper.design: Bomb Sapper: hunched husk goblin carrying a cracked rift-crystal bomb strapped on its back with a sputtering fuse, wild eyes, running pose. Attack: raising the bomb overhead.

warded.design: Warded Golem: a squat stone golem of sanctum masonry with a rune ward-ring floating around its torso (paint the ring NEUTRAL light grey; the game tints the ward by element). Attack: stone fist slam.

juggernaut.design: Massive rift-fused stone-and-iron hulk, shoulders >= 2x the head width, tiny sunk head, deep crimson seam glow, boulder fists, fills ~85% canvas width. Attack: overhead double-fist smash.

summoner.design: Rift Summoner: a robed husk priest holding a staff with a small torn portal hovering at its tip, chains of rift glyphs on the robe. Attack: staff raised, portal widening.

banner.design: Banner Imp: a wiry imp carrying a tall tattered war banner with a rift sigil (banner taller than the body, fluttering), horned head. Attack: banner thrust like a spear.

mimic.design: Prism Mimic: a crouched husk whose body is studded with prismatic crystal plates that look like they shift colour (paint them iridescent neutral-white), clawed hands. Attack: claw swipe.

ravager.design: ELITE: horned brute with a crown of rift-crystal horns, heavy spiked armour, a huge serrated cleaver, an accent rim of crimson. Must read as more dangerous than the juggernaut. Attack: charging slam pose with cleaver overhead.

riftling.design: Small rift spawn of the Rift Warden: a crystal-shard imp, shards jutting from the back, glowing crimson core. Attack: claw lunge.

mana_leech.design: Arcane Fractures: a gaunt floating leech-creature with a lamprey mouth, magenta runes drifting from its tail toward the mouth, mirror-shard fins. Attack: mouth lunges open.

crystal_parasite.design: Voidborn: a small tick-like parasite with a violet void-star carapace and long barbed legs made to latch onto crystal. Attack: rearing, barbs extended.

ash_imp.design: Ashen Horde: a charred imp of cracked cinder skin with ember-filled cracks and smoking horns, unstable glow in its belly. Attack: claw swipe, belly glowing brighter.

goblin_sprinter.design: Iron Legion: a lean goblin in riveted iron scrap armour with a gear-shaped buckler and a short pick, sprinting forward. Attack: pick stab.

ironback_golem.design: Iron Legion: a hulking golem with HEAVY RIVETED IRON PLATES over stone, gears visible at the joints, rust-orange accents, small furnace glow in the chest. Attack: plated fist slam.

spirit_splitter.design: Voidborn: a translucent two-faced spirit with a visible seam down the middle, violet void-light inside, trailing ectoplasm. Attack: both halves lunge.

spirit_wisp.design: Voidborn: a small fast fragment of the splitter, one face, comet-like void tail. Attack: dart forward.

flame_devourer.design: Ashen Horde: a gaunt creature with a gaping furnace maw that drinks fire, charred bone ribs, smoke pouring from vents on its back. Attack: maw open toward +X.

frost_wraith.design: Frozen Covenant: a hooded wraith of drifting rime and pale cyan mist with an ice crown, semi-translucent lower body, long clawed fingers. Attack: claw reach.

storm_harpy.design: Stormspire flyer: copper-feathered wings wider than tall, talons, violet lightning between the primaries with gold sparks, lifted >= 10% of the canvas above the foot row. Attack: talons forward dive.

stone_burrower.design: Iron Legion: a drill-snouted armoured burrower with iron-capped stone plates and digging claws, half-emerged posture (still feet on the foot row). Attack: drill snout thrust.

void_priest.design: Voidborn: a tall robed priest with a star-hole in the chest and a channeling staff topped with a void ring, violet hands. Attack: staff raised channeling.

hex_binder.design: Arcane Fractures: a caster bound in floating magenta seal-chains, a mirror-shard mask, a rune scroll unwinding from the hands. Attack: chains thrown toward +X.

siege_colossus.design: Iron Legion: a walking siege engine-golem with a mortar barrel on its back, iron plates, rust and soot, braced legs. Attack: braced, the barrel tilted forward (no shell drawn).

soul_binder.design: Voidborn: a priestess-like husk with three spectral threads rising from her hands, violet soul-lanterns at the hips. Attack: threads pulled taut.

spore_carrier.design: Corrupted Wilds: a bloated fungal husk with sacks of sick-green spores on its back, mushroom caps on the shoulders. Attack: hunched spore sacks pulsing.

ice_statue.design: Frozen Covenant: an immobile ice-knight statue on a frost plinth (plinth inside the canvas, base on the foot row), cracked glacial armour, a crown of icicles, glowing cyan eyes. a/b: subtle frost pulse; attack: eyes flaring.

mirror_knight.design: Arcane Fractures: a knight in mirror-polished plate with fractured mirror shards floating as a shield, a slim rapier, magenta glints. Attack: rapier lunge.

chaos_elemental.design: Arcane Fractures: a swirling elemental core of unstable shards cycling colours (paint shards in neutral prismatic white with mixed hints), no stable shape but a readable head and arms. Attack: arms flung forward.

rift_summoner.design: Voidborn: a robed summoner with a torn void rift hovering between its hands, star-speckled robes. Attack: rift held forward.

arcane_mimic.design: Arcane Fractures: a crouched mimic with an open book-like carapace full of copied runes, many small mirror eyes. Attack: carapace snapping open.

ember_hound.design: Ashen Horde: a lean charred hound with ember-filled cracks and a smoking mane, quadruped gallop. Attack: lunging bite.

thunder_drummer.design: Stormspire: a stocky drummer with a great copper war drum on its belly and feathered drumsticks, sparks on the drum skin. Attack: both sticks raised.

blight_shambler.design: Corrupted Wilds: a shambling mound of rotten bark, moss and sick-green ooze, glowing fungal growths. Attack: arm-root lash.

glacier_golem.design: Frozen Covenant: an ice golem carrying a FRONTAL ICE SHIELD slab facing +X, frosted stone body. Attack: shield slam forward.

storm_wisp.design: Stormspire flyer: a small orb of violet lightning with copper feather-vanes and a spark tail, lifted >= 10% of the canvas above the foot row. Attack: darting flare.

rootbound_treant.design: Corrupted Wilds: a gnarled corrupted treant with roots trailing like tentacles, sick-green knots glowing, a hollow face. Attack: roots lashing toward +X.

siegebreaker_golem.design: Mini-boss: a towering siege golem of sanctum stone bound with iron bands, a battering-ram arm, glowing armour seams that close at 50% (armour phase). Tell: ram arm drawn back, seams flaring. Attack: charge slam impact.

rift_warden.design: Final boss: the sanctum's ancient guardian statue animated and corrupted by the rift; basalt/obsidian plate, a broken halo of floating rift-crystal shards, a massive glaive held diagonally, a crimson-violet chest core behind cracked plates, a tattered stone-grey cloak. Tell: glaive raised high, halo shards flaring. Attack: glaive slammed down toward +X.

ignaroth.design: Ashen Horde: the Ember Tyrant, a horned magma-giant with cooling basalt crust over molten flesh, a crown of volcanic spikes, vents on the back that glow. Tell: arms raised, vents erupting light. Attack: fists into the ground.

seraphyne.design: Frozen Covenant: the Queen of Winter, tall and regal, an ice-spire crown, a gown that becomes glacier at the hem, a frost sceptre, floating snow. Tell: sceptre raised, frost gathering. Attack: sceptre pointed down.

gravemaw.design: Iron Legion: the Siege Titan, a colossal armoured titan with a gaping maw-like vent in the chest and mortar barrels on the shoulders, rust and soot. Tell: shoulders braced, barrels glowing. Attack: recoil after the volley.

vaelith.design: Stormspire: the Storm Tyrant (she), a winged tyrant in copper-feathered armour, a crown of lightning, a storm spear. Tell: spear raised, lightning gathering. Attack: spear thrust down.

mirrath.design: Arcane Fractures: the Mirror Queen, a queen whose body is half mirror-shards, a fractured mirror halo, a sceptre of magenta glass. Tell: arms spread, mirrors aligning. Attack: sceptre flash.

aetherion.design: Arcane Fractures: the Fallen Crystal - a dark mirror of the player's Crystal: a corrupted crystal colossus with a fractured core, floating broken facets, crystal arms. Tell: facets drawing in. Attack: arms thrown open.

thornmother.design: Corrupted Wilds: an ancient treant matriarch with a crown of thorns and blossoms of sick green, roots for a lower body, a cradle of thorns. Tell: roots lifting. Attack: thorn arms lashing.

ironclad_warlord.design: Iron Legion: a heavily armoured warlord in layered riveted plate with a great war banner on the back and a siege hammer. Tell: hammer raised. Attack: hammer down.

ashen_matriarch.design: Ashen Horde: brood mother of the imps, a hunched cinder giantess with a smouldering cocoon-like abdomen and ember-eyed imps clinging to her. Tell: arms raised, abdomen glowing. Attack: claws forward.

nyxhollow.design: Voidborn: the Hungering Void, a huge maw-creature of void flesh with star-holes, many-jointed arms and a ring of void eyes. Tell: maw opening, void light inside. Attack: lunging bite.
